solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Land in Spain, say

parts.note: E is the international vehicle registration letter for Spain
to say is to state

explanation.surface: A property somewhere in Spain, for example.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is a large area of land owned by one person or family.

clue.text: Analyst, formerly a Bevin boy?

parts.note: ex means former or once
Bevin Boys were young British men conscripted to work in coal mines in the Second World War

explanation.surface: A psychoanalyst who once worked down the pits.
explanation.definitionFit: An examiner scrutinises and analyses, inspecting something in detail.

clue.text: Toff's opening fine wine

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter

parts.note: fine means all right, okay

explanation.surface: An upper-class gentleman opens a good bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: Tokay is a sweet Hungarian dessert wine.

clue.text: Rough terrain for a coach

indicators.note: rough suggests the letters are roughed up into a new order

explanation.surface: Uneven ground suited to a vehicle or a sports coach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coach' suggests a bus on rough ground; here it is someone who trains.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainer is someone who coaches athletes or teams.

clue.text: Tricky question from trustee about wealth

indicators.note: the abbreviation for trustee goes around the word for wealth, so 'about' signals one piece enclosing another

parts.note: ease, as in a life of ease, means affluence or comfort

explanation.surface: A puzzling question put by someone who manages a fund about money.
explanation.definitionFit: A teaser is a puzzle or hard question meant to test someone.

clue.text: Helped nervous beadle to entertain knight

indicators.note: to entertain is to take in as a guest, so one piece holds the other
nervous means jittery, so the letters are shaken up

parts.note: N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A jittery parish official helped by hosting a knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nervous' rearranges BEADLE to EABLED, and 'to entertain' puts N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To enable is to make possible, so enabled means assisted or helped.

clue.text: Means of protection in East River in fast waves?

indicators.note: the compass point and river sit inside the rearranged letters
waves suggests the letters are tossed into a new order

parts.note: the Tyne is a river in north-east England

explanation.surface: A safeguard for swimmers on a fast-flowing eastern river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'waves' makes SAFT, which 'in' then opens around ETYNE; 'fast waves' reads as a description of the river.
explanation.definitionFit: A safety net literally catches a falling acrobat, and figuratively is any safeguard against hardship.

clue.text: Cavalier, perhaps, about a mosstrooper

indicators.note: the horseman word goes around the letter, so it is placed about it

parts.note: a cavalier is a horseman, a rider; perhaps flags the example

explanation.surface: A Royalist horseman considered as a border bandit.
explanation.definitionFit: Mosstroopers were seventeenth-century marauders of the Scottish Borders, mounted raiders.

clue.text: Shot in two parts of body

parts.note: the back is one part of the body
the hand is another part of the body

explanation.surface: Someone shot twice, wounded in two places.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot' suggests a wound; it is a stroke in tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: A backhand is a racket stroke played with the back of the hand facing forward.

clue.text: Have to surrounded by poverty? It's practical

indicators.note: the word for poverty goes around the other pieces

parts.note: dearth means scarcity or poverty
to have something is to own it

explanation.surface: Is living in poverty the sensible approach?
explanation.definitionFit: Down-to-earth means sensible and realistic, unpretentious and practical.

clue.text: Interest in a fine female voice

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
an air is a tune, something voiced or sung

explanation.surface: Someone takes an interest in a lovely woman's singing voice.
explanation.definitionFit: An affair is a matter of concern, something one has an interest or stake in.

clue.text: Orderly in fairly good trim

definitions.meaning: considerable, as in a decent sum of money

explanation.surface: Something neat and in reasonably good shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidy means neat (orderly, trim) and also, informally, considerable or fairly good.

clue.text: Current landlord brought round special printed update

indicators.note: the two words for current and landlord are placed around the letter for special, so they are brought round it

parts.note: current means new or up to date
a landlord lets property, so is a letter

explanation.surface: A present landlord has had a special notice delivered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' looks like electricity or water; it is the adjective meaning up to date.
explanation.definitionFit: A newsletter is a printed bulletin sent regularly to members with the latest news.

clue.text: Wild West character, on the ropes and worried

parts.note: a boxer on the ropes is in a desperate state

indicators.note: worried means shaken about, so the letters of 'and' are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cowboy in trouble and anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: Desperate Dan is the strongman cowboy of the British comic The Dandy, set in a Wild West town.

clue.text: A sausage one must have seasoning on to start with

indicators.note: the seasoning and 'on' come first, at the start, before the numeral

parts.note: pepper is a seasoning
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A sausage needs to be seasoned first.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy Italian-style dried sausage, often sliced on pizza.

clue.text: Go blue getting lower

parts.note: a go is a turn
blue means sad or down

explanation.surface: Becoming depressed and sinking lower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lower' reads as a comparative but is the verb: to turn down the volume is to lower it.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn down a heater or sound is to reduce or lower it.

clue.text: Valet's master key?

definitions.meaning: the manservant of Phileas Fogg in Jules Verne's Around the World in Eighty Days
a French term for a key that opens every lock

explanation.surface: The manservant holds the master key.
explanation.definitionFit: Passepartout is Fogg's valet in Verne's novel, and in French it literally means 'goes everywhere', a skeleton key.

clue.text: Southern peninsula, a vast region

parts.note: Iberia is the peninsula holding Spain and Portugal

explanation.surface: A southern peninsula forms a huge area.
explanation.definitionFit: Siberia is the immense northern part of Asian Russia.

clue.text: Dish — a number girl served up outside

indicators.note: the reversed name goes outside the number
in a down clue, served up means the name is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
ten is a number

explanation.surface: A meal dished up by a waitress, a number of courses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served up' gives NNA in a down clue, and 'outside' wraps it around the number; 'Dish' means a satellite dish, not food.
explanation.definitionFit: A satellite dish is a form of aerial for receiving signals.

clue.text: Lusting after paintings hanging round study

indicators.note: the word for paintings hangs around the word for study, enclosing it

parts.note: paintings collectively are art
a den is a private room or study

explanation.surface: Someone yearning for pictures hung in the study.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardent means passionate and eager, burning with desire.

clue.text: Commando, incompletely prepared, has to take a risk protecting monarch

parts.note: green means inexperienced or not yet ready

indicators.note: the wager word is placed round the royal abbreviation, guarding it

parts.note: to bet is to gamble or take a risk
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A half-trained commando has to gamble while guarding the king or queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A Green Beret is a member of the commandos, named for their headgear.

clue.text: Stick rook's taken from wader

indicators.note: the letter for rook is removed from the bird's name, so it is taken from it

parts.note: a crane is a long-legged wading bird
R is the chess notation for rook

explanation.surface: A stick that a rook has stolen from a heron-like bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rook' seems to be a bird alongside the wader, but it is the chess piece, R.
explanation.definitionFit: A cane is a walking stick or rod.

clue.text: Set of beliefs about leftist circle

parts.note: C is circa, Latin for about
a red is a communist or left-winger
O is shaped like a circle

explanation.surface: A doctrine concerning a group of left-wing activists.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a creed, a statement of what someone believes.

clue.text: Routed round roundabout route

indicators.note: round suggests turning the letters about into a new order

explanation.surface: Traffic sent round a circuitous road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' looks like part of the road picture; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A detour is a longer, indirect way taken to avoid something.

clue.text: Hospital rang one distraught dependant

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

indicators.note: distraught means very upset, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A hospital phoned a distressed relative.
explanation.definitionFit: A hanger-on is someone who attaches themselves to another for advantage, a parasitic follower.

clue.text: Head of Buchanans in court case concerning clan

indicators.note: the first letter is put inside the legal hearing

parts.note: a trial is a case heard in court

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: The chief of the Buchanans is in court over a clan matter.
explanation.walkthrough: The Buchanans are a Scottish clan, which helps the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Tribal means relating to a tribe, a clan or kinship group.

clue.text: Trail duck on small lake

parts.note: to trail is to lag behind
a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, O

explanation.surface: A duck trailing along on a pond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'duck' is the bird in the picture but the cricket zero, O.
explanation.definitionFit: A lagoon is a stretch of shallow water, often cut off from the sea, like a small lake.
